title: UI Blueprint
description: Machine-readable six-layer decomposition of a UI reference image: visual layout, component semantics, design tokens, data content, interaction behavior, and project implementation. The blueprint is authored by the model but every layer must be reconcilable against measurements (validate_blueprint.py). Code generation reads this file, never the raw image.

reference.description: Path to the reference image this blueprint decomposes

layout.description: Layer 1 - visual layout: canvas-level region decomposition. Bounds must come from measurement, not eyeballing.

track.description: component: DOM/CSS/SVG rebuild; island: region-scoped bitmap asset; approximation: third-party rendering pipeline (charts/maps/3D)

parent.description: Name of the containing region, omitted for top-level regions

relations.description: Inferred flex/grid relationships (infer_layout.py output, reviewed by the model). Prefer flow layout; fall back explicitly when inference is not trustworthy.

scope.description: Region name this relation lays out

items.description: Component ids or child region names in order

notes.description: Required when type is absolute-fallback: why inference was not trusted

components.description: Layer 2 - component semantics: what each thing IS, and which project component it maps to. Element ids must stay consistent with element-manifest.json and the rendered data-element attributes.

category.description: Ant Design-inspired component category. Use custom for project-specific composites.

content.description: Extracted text for text-bearing components; semantic description otherwise

maps_to.description: Project component and slot, e.g. 'src/components/StatCard:value' or 'NEW:WeatherCard'

style.description: Optional root surface/typography contract for the rendered data-component node.

elements.description: Fine-grained children carrying data-element ids; geometry from measured-primitives

item_bounds.description: Measured row/item rectangles for collection elements; codegen should map data rows into these slots.

requires_asset.description: True when this icon/image/media element must render from a measured asset crop, not a hand-drawn approximation.

asset_id.description: Stable id from element-assets.json; DOM must expose it via data-element-asset-id.

asset_path.description: Workbench/project-relative path to the measured asset crop.

asset_type.description: Asset classification from element-assets.json, e.g. icon/image/avatar/logo/map.

asset_source.description: How the asset was produced, e.g. primitive, region-track, ocr-text.

asset_role.description: Rendering role, e.g. element-asset or chart-reference-backing.

asset_policy.description: Optional policy used by codegen/materialization. For icon elements, 'trivial-vector' is the only non-asset exception for simple geometric glyphs.

render_asset_in_library.description: False for chart/map reference backings that feed structural comparison but should not render as a raw img.

token_refs.description: Names of tokens this element uses (color/typography/radius...)

runs.description: Composite typography spans for one text element; generated DOM must render one data-run node per entry.

tokens.description: Layer 3 - design tokens extracted from the image (extract_tokens.py output, curated by the model). Every color must be sampleable in the reference; every type size must come from measured text boxes.

sampled_at.description: [x, y] in reference coordinates where this color can be verified

maps_to.description: Existing project token to reuse instead, e.g. 'theme.colors.primary'

measured_from.description: Element id whose measured box supports this size

data.description: Layer 4 - data content: every data-driven component (table, list, chart, kpi group, timeline) declares its dataset here as mock data. Generated code renders FROM this data — a row/item template mapped over the array, or a chart library option fed the series — never as inline hard-coded sibling nodes, and never by drawing the data's appearance with bespoke SVG/CSS shapes. For lists/tables mock_data is the verbatim transcription of the reference content; for charts it is an approximate reading (series count, point count, value range, trend) rendered through the declared library.

fields.description: Field names of each rows/items entry, e.g. ["service", "region", "status", "latency"]

mock_data.description: The dataset itself. rows/items/series: non-empty array; keyvalue/tree/geo: object. Lives in the blueprint so codegen packets can carry it without re-reading the image.

binding.description: Prop or option path the data binds to, e.g. 'rows', 'items', 'option.series[0].data'

source.description: extracted: transcribed verbatim from the reference (lists/tables/labels); approximated: read approximately from the reference (chart values, map markers) — exact values are not the fidelity target, structure is

library.description: Third-party renderer for approximation-track data, e.g. 'echarts', 'leaflet', 'maplibre', 'three'

interactions.description: Layer 5 - interaction behavior. Never extracted from the image: derived from project conventions > project tokens > element-type defaults, and the source must be declared. Includes page-level behavior (tab switches, filters changing data, dialogs, loading/empty states).

behavior.description: What happens, e.g. 'switches content panel to the selected tab', 'opens detail modal'

source.description: Where this interaction design came from; interaction tokens must not be invented outside the project's system

implementation.description: Layer 6 - project implementation plan: generate with the target project's existing stack, never by pasting lab HTML.

framework.description: From project-profile, e.g. react, next, vue

final_dir.description: Project-relative directory where final components are written

target.description: Project component path to reuse/extend, or the new component's path

acceptance.description: Per-component acceptance criteria beyond the global gates

source.description: Where this style fact came from, e.g. measured, sampled, vlm-hint, project-token.

composition.description: Optional region-level foreground/background split. Backgrounds such as photos/maps/charts may be island or approximation assets; foreground overlays must remain component DOM with addressable data-element ids.

asset_policy.description: inpaint-clean: generate a cleaned background asset with foreground overlays removed; crop: raw crop, only valid without foreground; none: DOM/CSS background.

asset_element_id.description: data-element id of the background asset node.

library.description: Renderer for chart/map/3D backgrounds, e.g. echarts/leaflet/three.

generated_asset_path.description: Project/workbench-relative cleaned asset produced from this composition contract.

component_id.description: data-element id of the component overlay; must not be baked into the background.
